worksheet.title: Weekly Review Template
worksheet.description: Record your six key numbers and capture what to do next. This is your first weekly review — a habit you will keep for as long as you run your business.

fields.label: Traffic this week
fields.helpText: Total store visitors this week. Find in your platform's analytics dashboard.

fields.label: Conversion rate
fields.helpText: Percentage of visitors who bought. (orders ÷ visitors × 100). e.g. '2.3%'

fields.label: Average order value
fields.helpText: Total revenue ÷ total orders this week.

fields.label: CPA this week
fields.helpText: Total ad spend ÷ number of ad-attributed sales. Leave blank if not running ads yet.

fields.label: Actual margin per sale
fields.helpText: Real margin from your records this week. Compare to your Chapter 5 projection.

fields.label: Email list size
fields.helpText: Total subscribers on your email list right now. Find in your email platform.

fields.label: What is working
fields.helpText: One thing that performed well this week. What drove it? How can you do more of it?

fields.label: One thing to change
fields.helpText: The single most important thing to adjust next week. Specific and actionable.

fields.label: Updated Founder Rules
fields.helpText: Revise your kill, continue, and escalation criteria from Chapter 4 with the specific numbers you now have.
